jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square full-bleed medieval Serbian manuscript miniature for a Book of Legends. Inspired by Miroslav Gospel illumination and Sopocani/Decani fresco painting: FLAT perspective, dark fine contours, mineral cinnabar red, verdigris green, lapis blue, ochre, aged GOLD background, subtly worn parchment edges. Handmade tempera, restrained shading, no modern 3D. NO text, NO letters, NO frame or border. Scene fills entire square. Marko ALWAYS same man: long dark hair, thick BLACK moustache, strong straight nose, red cloak over chainmail, spiked mace. Sarac ALWAYS white-and-chestnut piebald/spotted horse. Scene: Young King Marko stands before the fortress of Prilep wearing a crown, spiked mace in hand, his white-and-chestnut piebald horse Sarac behind him. Reference image if supplied establishes Marko/Sarac identity and painting style only; create this new scene.
